methodologyNote: Measured via page views; OS families combined (e.g. Windows).
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Windows led operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Australia at 63.61% (market share of tracked page views / usage). OS X ranked second at 18.83%, followed by macOS at 12.89%.

faqs.question: Which item leads operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Australia?
faqs.answer: Windows leads at 63.61% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/os-market-share/desktop/australia.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Australia?
faqs.answer: Windows (63.61%), OS X (18.83%), macOS (12.89%) in October 2026.
